headline: China Bond Market Rattled by Debt Concerns at State Giant Zhuhai Huafa
summary: Concerns over the financial health of state-owned conglomerate Zhuhai Huafa Group rattled China’s bond market, highlighting pressures from the property crisis.
why: Financial distress among major state-backed conglomerates exposes systemic credit risks tied to local government financing and the broader real estate downturn.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Debt concerns at a major state-owned conglomerate rattled China's bond market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Anxiety over corporate solvency and local government debt burdens heightened credit risk perceptions across Chinese fixed-income markets.
